subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers keep this contributor branch as the landing path after a rebase/port/proof pass, or adopt the same fix in a fresh current-main branch?
rationale: The PR is assigned, stale against the active helper path, and proof-gated; automation cannot supply the contributor's real Copilot rotation proof or decide whether to adopt an external stale branch.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor port the cache ownership check to src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts, update current tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Maintainer adopts the fix
options.body: A maintainer can open a fresh narrow PR against current main if the bug is urgent and the contributor branch is not expected to recover.

options.title: Close after no response
options.body: If no rebase or proof arrives after maintainer follow-up, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor port the cache ownership check to src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts, update current tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current live assignee and has recent history on the active provider-auth helper.
